official_source_url.value: https://www.ics.gov.sc/faq/immigration-services/seychelles-bio-metric-passport — Immigration and Civil Status (ICS) Seychelles confirms that since the biometric passport was introduced (Nov 2022), applicants no longer submit a printed photo with their application. The photo is captured in person at the Passport Office during enrolment: "Upon completion of payment applicants submit their bio-data as follows: Image is taken, fingerprints and digital signature." No printed photo size/background/format specification for applicant-submitted photos is published, because none is required.
